Lee Park: Morning team — Lee here, joining DevOps today (formerly at GrayTech). Starting remote this week. Quick q: I didn't get access to the devops-prod role in Okta. Who should I ping? Also my machine needs the VPN cert and the dotfiles repo. Thanks! :wave:
Maya (IT): welcome Lee! :wave: I just approved your hardware ticket. For Okta access ping me and @Ben R. I can add you to devops-prod after manager approval. What's your employee id?
Lee Park: thanks Maya — emp id 23457. Also I tried the MDM enroll link and got 'device not eligible'.
Maya (IT): try re-enrolling with this command on mac: ```sudo profiles renew -type enrollment``` If it fails, send me the MDM error screenshot. Also what's your laptop model?
Ben R.: hey Lee, I'll handle the IAM side once Maya gives the green light. In the meantime, you can use the staging role: role_staging/devops. SSH keys go into ~/.ssh/redwood_id_rsa.pub — paste into the dotfiles repo and ping me.
Lee Park: copied. One more: who's owning the infra runbook and Slack alerts for nightly batch jobs? I might need context for on-call later.
Aisha S.: hi Lee — I'm on the infra runbook. I'll DM you the runbook link and add you to rotation docs. Also +1 to joining #eng-oncall and #eng-infra channels.
Samir (Eng): welcome! If you want to grab a quick pairing to walk through the CI and deploy flow, I can do 30m this afternoon.
Lee Park: that would be great, Samir. I'll send a calendar invite for 3pm PT. :calendar:
DevSignupBot: New hire checklist updated: Lee Park added to group 'devops'. Onboarding tasks: 4/8 complete. https://redwood.internal/onboard/23457
Maya (IT): added you to Okta group, Lee. Try login and confirm.
Lee Park: confirmed — can access devops-staging and pulled dotfiles. MDM enroll succeeded after running the command. Big thanks everyone! :tada:
